title: Russia accused of violating Polish airspace after missile explodes near village
summary_full: Polish PM heads to scene of crater thought to have occurred during deadly wave of attacks on Ukraine Russia has been accused of violating Polish airspace after a missile exploded in a field in the east of the country during a massive air raid that killed 13 people in neighbouring Ukraine.Polish authorities said that an explosion, near the village of Tarnawa-Kolonia, close to Lublin, had created a 10-metre-wide crater, occurring as Russia staged new missile attacks on Ukraine.
